operator_direction: Install the verified Console OS 0.4.23 controller-first candidate on the bound Waveshare 4.3 to test the guarded ESP32-P4 HS-root FS/LS clock correction through the externally powered H2 hub. Reuse the existing factory backup; write only the primary application, preserve bootloader, partition table, OTA state, NVS, and microSD, and retain H1 UART for automatic safe-mode recovery evidence.

fixture.h2: operator-attested externally powered USB-C hub with power input
fixture.scope: bounded powered-hub enumeration and controller-first hot-plug behavior

ota_data.live_policy: mutable boot-selection state; preserve without writing

nvs.live_policy: preserve; candidate may write only existing Console OS settings and the p4_console/usb_enum_probe recovery marker through NVS APIs

upstream_reference.scope: Espressif engineer's experimental P4/S31 force-FS correction; locally adapted without modifying ESP-IDF or the managed USB package

safety_contract: leave ESP-IDF, the managed espressif/usb 1.5.0 package, and its hub scheduler byte-for-byte unchanged
generate both replacement translation units only from exact hash-bound upstream inputs
gate every new HCD register write and downstream retry with the durable one-boot NVS probe
on an incomplete prior boot, suppress HCD reapplication and retries so the stable 0.4.22 path reaches READY
before each guarded root reset set FSLSSupp=1 and FSLSPclkSel=0
after guarded root enable use FSLSPclkSel 2 and HFIR 5999 for low speed, otherwise FSLSPclkSel 0 and HFIR 29999
report an unexpected high-speed root result as full speed only while the guarded correction is active
wait for failed-child recycle and parent hub control completion before any bounded downstream retry
retain direct microSD mount, lazy MSC allocation, and mutually exclusive USB Drive app transition
preserve the 768x480 BBS shell, official gamechangersai.org logo, saved audio levels, touch, dynamic SD games, and existing microSD contents

acceptance_required_after_install: retained H1 UART shows exactly one candidate app start, App version 0.4.23, USB_ENUM_GUARD state=armed, and Console OS READY
P4_HS_FSLS_ROOT_READY reports fslssupp=1, pclk_sel=0, frame_interval=29999, and effective_speed=1 for the full-speed powered hub
no panic, assert, watchdog, brownout, repeated reset, hub-control ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE, or usbh_dev_close assertion occurs

if the candidate crashes before confirmation, the immediately following boot shows USB_ENUM_GUARD state=safe-mode; neither P4_HS_FSLS_ROOT_READY nor a retry dispatch may appear, and Console OS must reach READY

the low-speed attached child reaches a bounded HID interface and captured descriptor without destabilizing display, audio, touch, or microSD; a failed descriptor remains a failed controller acceptance even if the OS stays stable
after approximately 9.6 seconds of stable runtime UART shows USB_ENUM_GUARD state=confirmed
subsequent manual acceptance separately covers every mapped controller input, keyboard, mouse, held-input unplug neutralization, repeated hot-plug, and at least 30 minutes of gameplay
USB Drive remains an explicit app-only role switch and is qualified separately after controller enumeration
